Sharing my research

Why I blog, and what's in these.

Most of what I learn in a week never leaves a terminal buffer. This section is an attempt to fix that: short write-ups of problems I worked through, cool plots and the code that made them, and interesting things I’ve written about in science.

Expect notes and snippets of all sizes and forms.
